title: Mint-Coriander Chutney
description: A bright, tangy green chutney blended from fresh mint and coriander with a little lemon and green chilli — the standard dip for samosas and pakoras.

ingredients.name: Roasted Chana Dal
ingredients.notes: for body and a thicker texture

steps: Wash the coriander and mint leaves thoroughly and roughly chop.
Add the coriander, mint, green chillies, lemon juice, roasted chana dal, salt and sugar (if using) to a blender.
Blend, adding water a tablespoon at a time, until you get a smooth, thick, spoonable chutney.
Taste and adjust salt or lemon juice as needed. Transfer to a serving bowl.
Store any extra in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3-4 days.
